measurement_notes: Shared Linux host; CPU 3 pinned, no exclusive CPU or fixed-frequency guarantee.
Five alternating before/after samples per case; warmup 256 operations. Repeats calibrated from the original binary toward 150 ms and held equal across profiles.
Fast optimized cases can run substantially less than 150 ms. Report medians, retain every sample, and treat small differences as noise.
CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID excludes descheduling; CLOCK_MONOTONIC wall time is also retained. User PMU counters use acknowledged perf enable/disable around the warmed loop.
Canonical scalar operations process 256 u64 values each. Frame payloads are 64, 4096, or 65536 bytes. Flat vector/string payloads are 4096 bytes; nested strings contain 16 x 64 bytes.
Common numbers use finite binary64 exponents 1010..1039. Wide corpus stratifies the finite exponent field 0..2046; each fixed corpus has 256 values.
Allocation counters in this baseline intercept tracking_allocator<190> container calls only. They do not count direct virtual-memory reservations or all library heap calls.
The normal symbolic caller-scratch path also passes a separate MICRON_ABC_STATS zero-heap-allocation assertion.
The original benchmark and final harness differ only in wasm conditional compilation; their native operation and timing code is identical.
Native x86 performance measurements only. ARM QEMU execution and wasm Node execution establish correctness and executable benchmark coverage, not native throughput comparisons.

independent_reviews.scope: Decimal limb expansion, cached powers, scanner state, SIMD compaction and access widths, constexpr fallbacks.
checks: One million seeded bounded/unbounded scanner comparisons, including non-ASCII bytes, long discarded tails, and float32.
GCC SSE2 and Clang ASan+UBSan probes.
ARM32/AArch64 isolated digit kernels with GCC and Clang, little endian; isolated big-endian probes with the platform rejection bypassed only in the probes.
Follow-up review and probes after NEON packing optimization.

independent_reviews.scope: Container reuse, object lifetimes, malformed counts, terminators, bounds, canonical magic comparison.
checks: ASan+UBSan lifetime/growth/shrink/truncation/leak and guard-page probes for strings and flat/fixed containers.
Malformed padded nested frame allocation reproduction.
Final magic-header guard probe: constexpr, short counts 0..15, exact page-end payloads 0..64, all 255 incorrect values at each magic byte.

findings.issue: Eager nested resize constructed and allocated all claimed children before validating the first child.
findings.fix: Reuse existing elements; parse each new child successfully before appending; shrink after success. Add malformed-count regressions.

independent_reviews.scope: Stack/local/external scratch lifetimes, arbint conversion boundaries and exponent formatting, perf handshake.
checks: ASan+UBSan bases 2..36, bounded and unbounded integers, active limb counts 31/32/33, canaries, sign/exponent extrema, and sink rejection.
Perf control/acknowledgement smoke for all configured counters.
Source follow-up confirming identical max_limbs arithmetic guard on both symbolic writer overloads.

findings.issue: The new caller-scratch overload initially omitted the default writer max_limbs overflow gate.
findings.fix: Apply the identical arithmetic guard before formatting and add a regression using an ordinary small symbol with an oversized configured limit.
findings.status: resolved; extreme allocations were not attempted

limitations: No full repository compiler matrices or unrelated rigor suites were run.
Wasm symbolic arenas require unavailable virtual-memory reservation and are excluded; decimal, canonical, and container serialization paths run in wasm scalar and SIMD builds.
Whole-library big-endian builds remain unsupported. Isolated big-endian kernel probes do not imply whole-library support.
Focused passing tests and reviews do not establish absence of every possible defect.
